regime_context: The detector shows a very narrow, one-narrative China A-shares regime: only 2 of 22 themes are trend-gate eligible, Coal leads with a thin margin over Gold Miners, and Banks are crowded. Crucially, gate_helps is false — the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on this market's history — and the track record's directional accuracy is 0.337, so this note must be exceptionally humble and short.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Gold Miners (rank 2, score 0.935) becomes trend-gate eligible (currently eligible=false with durability_bar 0.31) — if its eligibility flips true with a durability bar above 0.5 and Coal's 515220.SS simultaneously breaks its 20-day relative trend vs CSI 300, that would retire the watch on a confirmed Coal→Gold handoff.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only high-scoring theme that is both trend-gate eligible and uncrowded, with the ranking showing top-of-table score (0.992) and a durability bar above 0.5. This is a focus/liquidity lens rather than a return forecast, but within the narrow eligible set it is the cleanest expression of prevailing leadership. The one_narrative flag means leadership concentration is extreme, so the bar for overruling it is high.
evidence: buster: gate_helps=false on this market, so trend eligibility carries no proven drawdown edge here
theses.dissent: Coal's own hurst_tag is 'mean-revert', so the top rank may reflect a short-term spike that the trend gate cannot ride — and this market's history shows the gate whipsaws rather than protects.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS (Coal ETF proxy) underperforms CSI 300 by more than 4% before 2026-11-05

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are eligible and high-scoring but flagged crowded (crowding_z 1.83). Per the guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution, not a sell. Given the overall detector has no validated forward edge on this market and the dominant Coal narrative is mean-reverting, the crowded high-eligibility theme carries the most two-way risk; a cautious lean away from being the marginal buyer is warranted.
evidence: track_record dir_accuracy 0.337 — default low conviction for any directional lean
theses.dissent: Banks' durability_bar is 0.83 and breadth is 1.0 — the strongest absolute trend-health on the table — so underweighting the most broadly-held eligible trend could miss continued leadership if Coal mean-reverts.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS (Banks ETF proxy) outperforms CSI 300 by more than 3% before 2026-11-05

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
